audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple paths claim Blinding Dart shuts down Decimate (Q): whys[0] says "his Hemorrhage stacks cannot build and his passive Decimate Q heals nothing", early says "his Decimate (Q) heal only procs when he actually hits autos that land, which they do not", wants.you[0] says "his passive Decimate heal never procs".
audit.why: Blind only causes basic attacks to miss. Decimate is an ability, not a basic attack and not a passive — per the kit it deals damage in a circle and "Darius heals based on enemy champions and large monsters hit by the blade". Hemorrhage also stacks from "attacks and damaging abilities", so a blinded Darius still bleeds you and still heals with Q. Telling a Teemo the blind removes his heal will get players killed standing in the blade half of Decimate.
audit.corrected: Blind removes his basic attacks (and therefore Crippling Strike's payload and auto-driven Hemorrhage stacking), but Decimate still swings, still applies Hemorrhage and still heals off the outer-blade hit. Blind is an auto-attack answer here, not an all-in answer.
sources: champ-data/_kits/darius.json (Q Decimate: heal flag, 'heals based on enemy champions ... hit by the blade'; P Hemorrhage: 'attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed')
champ-data/_kits/teemo.json (Q Blinding Dart: 'blinding it for the duration')

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] says a wasted Apprehend means "he loses his only stick tool for four seconds"; mid says "if he wastes Apprehend you have a four-second window".
audit.why: Apprehend's real cooldown is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16 seconds. Four seconds is off by roughly 6x at rank 1 and understates the single most important window in the matchup — a Teemo who thinks the window is 4s will disengage while he still had 20+ seconds of free poison stacking.
audit.corrected: A baited rank-1 Apprehend gives you 26 seconds; even rank 5 gives 16. That is the window to walk up and stack Toxic Shot, not a four-second peek.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text calls Decimate a pull: "his Decimate pull is the only threatening button he has before Level 2".
audit.why: Decimate (Q) is a circular axe swing with an inner handle / outer blade split. The pull is Apprehend (E), which he does not have at Level 1. Naming the wrong ability as the pull teaches the wrong spacing cue.
audit.corrected: At Level 1 he has Decimate only, and Decimate is a swing, not a pull — the pull (Apprehend, 535 range) does not exist until he puts a point in E.
sources: champ-data/_kits/darius.json (Q Decimate; E Apprehend 'sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him', range 535)

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text writes the ability name "Blinding Shot"; whys[0] and early also write "Blinding Shot".
audit.why: Teemo's Q is Blinding Dart. "Blinding Shot" is not an ability in the game.

With a standard Q max, Blinding Dart is rank 2 at level 4 and rank 3 at level 5; it is not maxed until level 9. Blinding Dart's cooldown is a flat 7s at every rank anyway, so ranking it up does not create the spike this line implies — the actual 4-5 spike is shroom coverage.
audit.corrected: Q is rank 2-3 at this stage. The stage advantage comes from mushroom coverage of the tribush entrances, not from a Q rank.
sources: champ-data/_kits/teemo.json (Q Blinding Dart cooldown '7' — flat across ranks)

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5] and spikes[3].text call the item "Liandry's Angueur".
audit.why: No such item. The Itemization line in this same matchup's full layer already writes it correctly as Liandry's Torment, so the content layer is internally inconsistent with the full layer.
56.9% over 1443 games is the Emerald+ figure in the packet and the entry is presented as FAVOURED (4/10 difficulty) — consistent.
Level chart gives Teemo 6/7 stages with Skill at 2+ items, which matches a 56.9% win rate and the standard Darius-scales-into-teamfights shape. No contradiction to fix.
sources: scratchpad packet teemo.json entry darius levelChart

notes: DATA-WIDE (not Darius-specific): (1) champ-data/_kits/teemo.json derives a "knockup" flag on R Noxious Trap — that is a false positive; mushrooms slow and damage, they do not displace. _missing-interactions.json inherits it and emits a bogus "Both sides carry displacement (Noxious Trap (R) vs Apprehend (E))" rule for this matchup, which I did not act on. (2) "Liandry's Angueur" appears across many Teemo content entries; the full layer writes "Liandry's Torment". I only corrected the two occurrences in this matchup — a repo-wide find/replace is worth running. (3) Blinding Dart's cooldown is a flat 7s at all ranks, so any Teemo line implying a Q spike from ranking it up is wrong; several entries also say "Q is max-ranked" at Levels 4-5, which is impossible before level 9.
